what: the reader hands out live settings
expect: test/suite/fork-subagents-service.test.ts > the read-only surface hands out frozen settings, and a reread replaces them with a new frozen object

what: a conversation subscriber is never called
expect: test/suite/fork-subagents-service.test.ts > the read-only surface hands out a running child's conversation and its changes, and none for a queued agent
test/suite/fork-subagents-service.test.ts > the read-only surface numbers queued agents by their place in the queue, and a running one not at all

what: the writer stores values the reader drops
expect: test/fork-builtins/subagents/settings.test.ts > subagent settings refuses a value the reader would drop, naming its key, and leaves settings.json as it was

what: the writer follows a symlinked .pi or settings.json
expect: test/fork-builtins/subagents/settings.test.ts > subagent settings refuses to write through a symlinked .pi or settings.json, dangling or not

what: the temporary file is opened without the exclusive flag
expect: test/fork-builtins/subagents/atomic-write.test.ts > writeFileAtomically refuses when its temporary path exists, and neither overwrites nor deletes what is there

what: a failed rename leaves the temporary file behind
expect: test/fork-builtins/subagents/atomic-write.test.ts > writeFileAtomically leaves the target and no temporary file when the rename fails

what: an existing settings.json is written in place
expect: test/fork-builtins/subagents/settings.test.ts > subagent settings replaces an existing settings.json whole, and leaves it byte-identical when the rename fails
